purpose: Say that an amount or degree goes beyond what is suitable.
keywords: ます-stem / い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + すぎる.
The room is so quiet that I cannot relax.
formation: ます-stem / い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + すぎる.
restrictions: すぎる conjugates as an ichidan verb.
mistake: Remove the final い of an い-adjective before adding すぎる.
